purpose: Default reference for stakeholder baseline accuracy in reports; distinct from best observed Codex accuracy
evidence_status: Historical stakeholder/project figures, not independently reproduced or verified against original prediction files here
percentage_convention: Correct/28 multiplied by 100, rounded to one decimal place
unavailable_provenance: The original prediction artifacts and measurement command have not been established; do not invent them or present these as a fresh measurement
reporting_policy: Baseline accuracy means these historical stakeholder figures. Best observed Codex accuracy means the separate pinned best-accuracy reference. This reporting convention does not establish a paired evaluation or replace the requirement to measure comparison systems on identical held-out alerts.
